title: There are three levels of the disinfection of the patient equipment:
subject: subj:pubhealth1

body.stem: There are three levels of the disinfection of the patient equipment:
options: High-level disinfection called the critical level: this will destroy all microorganisms, with the exception of heavy contamination by bacterial spores
High-level disinfection called the critical level: this will destroy all microorganisms, even the heavy contamination by bacterial spores
Intermediate disinfection called semi-critical: this inactivates Mycobacterium tuberculosis, vegetative bacteria, most viruses and most fungi, but does not necessarily kill bacterial spores

Low-level disinfection called non-critical: this can kill most bacteria, some viruses and some fungi, but cannot be relied on for killing more resistant bacteria such as M. tuberculosis or bacterial spores
Low-level disinfection called non-critical: this can kill most bacteria, some viruses and some fungi, and even more resistant bacteria such as M. tuberculosis but not bacterial spores
